status: Original circuit-level selection and pixel placement study; no released PCB or Gerber

sources.title: Würth 150060YS75000
sources.fact: Yellow 0603; 590 nm; Vf typ 2.0/max 2.4 V at 20 mA; 30 mA continuous absolute maximum at 25 C; land footprint 2.4×0.8 mm.

sources.title: TI LP5860
sources.fact: LP5860RKPR; 11 scan rows×18 sinks, not 198 simultaneously driven current outputs; SPI up to 12 MHz; VSYNC high >=200 us.

sources.title: ST STM32G474
sources.fact: STM32G474RET6, LQFP64, 512 KB flash, 170 MHz; serial peripherals and MCU voltage constraints.

sources.title: ST Nucleo G4 user manual
sources.fact: NUCLEO-G474RE; board revision and power jumpers must be recorded.

sources.title: Microchip LAN9252
sources.fact: DS00001909C: SPI PDI; integrated PHYs; LAN9252I/PT industrial TQFP-EP ordering convention. Typical two-PHY traffic: (112+82) mA at 3.3 V with internal regulators and magnetics.

sources.title: Microchip SPI evaluation board
sources.fact: Evaluation platform, not claimed to fit inside final head.

sources.title: Microchip LAN9252 reference schematic
sources.fact: Reference includes 24FC512 and Pulse J0011D01BNL; custom board still requires full schematic and layout.

sources.title: Microchip EEPROM
sources.fact: 24FC512-I/SN: 512 Kbit I2C EEPROM, SOIC8; SII image/address/WP must be configured.

sources.title: Pulse Ethernet connector guide
sources.fact: J0011D01BNL 100BASE-TX integrated magnetic RJ45; package and operating temperature require head review.

sources.title: TI 24-to-5 V buck
sources.fact: TPS54360BDDAR, 60 V input family/3.5 A; external inductor, diode, compensation and thermal design required.

sources.title: TI LED rail buck
sources.fact: TPS62130ARGTR, 3–17 V input, 3 A; proposed 5-to-3.3 V_LED.

sources.title: TI logic rail buck
sources.fact: TPS62162DSGR, fixed 3.3 V /1 A from 5 V; external components/layout required.

sources.title: TI input eFuse
sources.fact: TPS26600PWPR: 60 V /2 A family, reverse input polarity, programmable current/UVLO/OVP; not a safety power-removal function.

sources.title: TI local LED power switch
sources.fact: TPS2553DBVR, adjustable current-limited power distribution switch; per-board limit resistor and fault behavior to qualify.

sources.title: JST GH connector
sources.fact: GHR-10V-S + BM10B-GHS-TBT(LF)(SN) + SSHL-002T-P0.2; 1 A at AWG26; 50 V; positive latch; wire OD 0.76–1.0 mm.

sources.title: Phoenix 24 V entry
sources.fact: MC 1,5/2-G-3,81 1803277 with mate 1803578; 8 A header, without locking, fixed bench only.

sources.title: Littelfuse input TVS
sources.fact: SMBJ33A: 33 V stand-off, 53.3 V specified clamp at rated pulse; source impedance and pulse energy still needed.

sources.title: Murata NCU18_S temperature NTC
sources.fact: NCU18XH103F6SRB: 10 kohm at 25 C +/-1%, B25/50 3380 K +/-1%; board temperature observation, not LED junction-temperature measurement.

sources.title: TI low-capacitance signal ESD array
sources.fact: TPD4E05U06DQAR candidate for exposed logic signals; placement/ground return and Ethernet applicability must be reviewed.

sources.title: Murata NCP15/18 NRND notice
sources.fact: Updated 2025-03-31: NCP15/18 not recommended for new designs; manufacturer recommends NCU15/18. Replaces the previous NCP18XH103F03RB prototype candidate.

assumptions.finger_drive_control: four independent EtherCAT slaves F1-F4; MCU only light/sensors/IO

calculations.warning: Power is an analytic screen with explicit assumptions, not measured photometry, guaranteed efficiency, junction temperature or fault-safe current. Scan blanking reduces average below 1/11 bound.
